description: This Java class implements a command strategy for handling batch requests to create transactions for loans identified by external IDs. It parses the request URL to extract parameters, delegates transaction creation to the LoanTransactionsApiResource, and constructs the batch response based on success or failure.

classes.name: CreateTransactionByLoanExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A Spring component implementing command strategy to create loan transactions by external IDs, handling request parsing and response formation.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the batch request by parsing URL parameters, invoking the loan transaction API, and returning a batch response with status and body.
